info.name: CyberSource Merged Spec bankAccountValidation orders API

items.docs: A create order request enables you to send the itemized details along with the order. This API can be used by merchants initiating their transactions with the create order API.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID returned from the original create order response.

items.docs: This API can be used in two flavours - for updating the order as well as saving the order.
